name: Kitano Mai
source:
The daughter of Miyamura's younger sister. A popular idol who has found roles in many different media. She was suddenly kidnapped by criminal organizations while on her job.

Suddenly returned home after a long period absent, she denies being kidnapped and claims that it was her frustration of work that caused her to run away from home. Because of her claims, the investigation was dropped.
